description: This file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of a CursorLoader within a ListFragment to load and display contacts from the device's Contacts database. It includes a nested static class for the ListFragment which manages search filtering and loader callbacks.

classes.name: LoaderRetained
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes and manages the fragment displaying contacts via cursor loader.

classes.name: LoaderRetained.CursorLoaderListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that manages loading contacts data using CursorLoader, displays it in a list, and provides search filtering functionality.

classes.name: LoaderRetained.CursorLoaderListFragment.MySearchView
classes.description: Custom SearchView class overriding default collapse behavior to clear search text on collapse.

methods.name: onCreate()
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the contact list fragment if not already present.

methods.name: onActivityCreated()
methods.description: Sets up the list, adapter, and initializes the loader.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu()
methods.description: Creates and configures the search menu with custom SearchView.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange()
methods.description: Handles changes in search query, updates filter, and restarts loader to refresh data.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit()
methods.description: No action needed on submit; returns true.

methods.name: onClose()
methods.description: Clears search query when search view is closed.

methods.name: onListItemClick()
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items, currently logging the clicked item ID.

methods.name: onCreateLoader()
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader for contacts, applying current search filter.

methods.name: onLoadFinished()
methods.description: Swaps in new cursor data and shows list.
